steps.text:
$(1) \Rightarrow (2)$ ：首先证明“幂等矩阵的秩等于它的迹”

设 $A$ 是 $n$ 阶幂等矩阵，且 $\operatorname{rank}(A) = r$ ，则存在可逆矩阵 $P, Q$ 使得

$$
\boldsymbol {A} = \boldsymbol {P} \left( \begin{array}{c c} \boldsymbol {I} _ {r} & \boldsymbol {0} \\ \boldsymbol {0} & \boldsymbol {0} \end{array} \right) \boldsymbol {Q}.
$$

由 $A^2 = A$ 得

$$
\begin{array}{r l} P \left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {r} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \end{array} \right) Q P \left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {r} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \end{array} \right) Q & = P \left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {r} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \end{array} \right) Q \\ & \Rightarrow \left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {r} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \end{array} \right) Q P \left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {r} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \end{array} \right) = \left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {r} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \end{array} \right). \end{array}\tag{①}
$$

将 $QP$ 分块，记 $QP = \begin{pmatrix} M_{11} & M_{12} \\ M_{21} & M_{22} \end{pmatrix}$ ，代入①式可得 $M_{11} = I_r$ 。则有

$$
\operatorname{tr} (A) = \operatorname{tr} \left(P \left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {r} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \end{array} \right) Q\right) = \operatorname{tr} \left(\left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {r} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \end{array} \right) Q P\right)

= \operatorname{tr} \left(\left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {r} & 0 \\ 0 & 0 \end{array} \right) \left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {r} & M _ {1 2} \\ M _ {2 1} & M _ {2 2} \end{array} \right)\right) = \operatorname{tr} \left(\left( \begin{array}{c c} I _ {r} & M _ {1 2} \\ 0 & 0 \end{array} \right)\right) = r.
$$

若 $A_{1}, A_{2}, \cdots, A_{m}$ 都是幂等矩阵，则由上面的结论得

$$
\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} \operatorname{rank} (A _ {i}) = \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {m} \operatorname{tr} (A _ {i}) = \operatorname{tr} (I _ {n}) = n.
$$

(2) $\Rightarrow$ (3): 考虑 $n^{2} \times n^{2}$ 块对角矩阵.

$$
\left( \begin{array}{c c c c c} A _ {1} & & & & \\ & A _ {2} & & & \\ & & A _ {3} & & \\ & & & \ddots & \\ & & & & A _ {m} \end{array} \right) \xrightarrow [ i = 2 , \cdots m ]{(I) r _ {i} + r _ {1}} \left( \begin{array}{c c c c c} A _ {1} & A _ {2} & A _ {3} & \dots & A _ {m} \\ & A _ {2} & & \\ & & A _ {3} & \\ & & & \ddots \\ & & & & A _ {m} \end{array} \right) \xrightarrow [ i = 2 , \cdots m ]{c _ {i} (I) + c _ {1}} \left( \begin{array}{c c c c c} I _ {n} & A _ {2} & A _ {3} & \dots & A _ {m} \\ A _ {2} & A _ {2} & & \\ A _ {3} & & A _ {3} & \\ \vdots & & & \ddots \\ A _ {m} & & & & A _ {m} \end{array} \right)

\xrightarrow [ i = 2 , \cdots m ]{c _ {1} (- A _ {i}) + c _ {i}} \left( \begin{array}{c c c c c} I _ {n} & 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 \\ A _ {2} & A _ {2} - A _ {2} ^ {2} & - A _ {2} A _ {3} & \dots & - A _ {2} A _ {m} \\ A _ {3} & - A _ {3} A _ {2} & A _ {3} - A _ {3} ^ {2} & \dots & - A _ {3} A _ {m} \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ A _ {m} & - A _ {m} A _ {2} & - A _ {m} A _ {3} & \dots & A _ {m} - A _ {m} ^ {2} \end{array} \right) \xrightarrow [ i = 2 , \cdots m ]{(- A _ {i}) r _ {1} + r _ {i}} \left( \begin{array}{c c c c c} I _ {n} & 0 & 0 & \dots & 0 \\ 0 & A _ {2} - A _ {2} ^ {2} & - A _ {2} A _ {3} & \dots & - A _ {2} A _ {m} \\ 0 & - A _ {3} A _ {2} & A _ {3} - A _ {3} ^ {2} & \dots & - A _ {3} A _ {m} \\ \vdots & \vdots & \vdots & & \vdots \\ 0 & - A _ {m} A _ {2} & - A _ {m} A _ {3} & \dots & A _ {m} - A _ {m} ^ {2} \end{array} \right).
$$

所以 $\mathrm{rank}(A_{1})+\mathrm{rank}(A_{2})+\cdots+\mathrm{rank}(A_{m})=n$ ，当且仅当右下角的 $(n^{2}-n)\times(n^{2}-n)$ 阶矩阵为 0，即 $A_{i}(i\geqslant2)$ 都是幂等矩阵且相互正交.

对 $i = 1$ 的情况，在等式 $A_{1} + A_{2} + \dots +A_{m} = I_{n}$ 两边，左乘 $A_{j}(j\geqslant 2)$ ，有

$$
A _ {j} A _ {1} + A _ {j} ^ {2} = A _ {j} \Rightarrow A _ {j} A _ {1} = 0.
$$

所以命题（3）成立.

(3) $\Rightarrow(1)$ ：在等式 $A_{1}+A_{2}+\cdots+A_{m}=I_{n}$ 两边，左乘 $A_{1}$ ，有

$$
A _ {1} ^ {2} + A _ {1} \left(A _ {2} + \dots + A _ {m}\right) = A _ {1} \Rightarrow A _ {1} ^ {2} = A _ {1}.
$$

这说明 $A_{1}$ 是幂等矩阵，对其他 $A_{i}$ 也完全类似，这就完成了全部证明.

meta.commentary:
评注（1）该题的结论又称为矩阵的“正交幂等性质”.

(2) 注意在该题证明中得到的另一个结论：若 $A$ 是幂等矩阵，则 $\operatorname{rank}(A) = \operatorname{tr}(A)$ .

(3) 通过此题可再次休会上题评注的意义.
